finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0** in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits. About 40 matter.

Four break callers. Error types stopped being re-exported from five modules. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. The v1 export route is gone. The latency histogram unit changed, so dashboards shift. All four were filed as `refactor` or `fix`, not flagged.

One feature. Webhook retries with backoff.

Two things to check. Six `docs: note the minimum node version` commits and CI moved to node 22, but no commit says the floor. Confirm it and add it. Runtime deps bumped were `fastify`, `undici`, `pg`, `knex`, `ioredis`, `pino`, `zod`, `dotenv`, `nanoid`, all patch or minor.
